penalty_pool.title: PENALTY ZONE: THE DESERT
penalty_pool.description: Daily targets were missed. The System has transported you to the Penalty Zone. You must survive the forced march to unlock your interface.

penalty_pool.title: PENALTY ZONE: HIGH GRAVITY
penalty_pool.description: Failure to complete the Daily Quest has resulted in a localized gravity shift. Weakness is not tolerated.

penalty_pool.title: PENALTY ZONE: POISONOUS SWARM
penalty_pool.description: The System detects lethargy. A swarm is approaching. You must keep moving to evade the venom.

penalty_pool.title: PENALTY ZONE: OXYGEN DEPLETION
penalty_pool.description: Your biological engine has stalled. The System is forcing a hard reboot of your cardiovascular system.

penalty_pool.title: PENALTY ZONE: THE SWAMP
penalty_pool.description: The ground is sinking. You must maintain absolute full-body tension to avoid being pulled under.

targets.E-Rank: 3x30 sec Hollow Body Hold, 3x30 sec Superman Hold
targets.D-Rank: 4x40 sec Hollow Body Hold, 4x40 sec Superman Hold
targets.C-Rank: 5x60 sec Hollow Body Hold, 5x60 sec Superman Hold
targets.B-Rank: 5x90 sec Hollow Body Hold, 5x90 sec Superman Hold
targets.A-Rank: 5x120 sec Hollow Body Hold, 5x120 sec Superman Hold

penalty_pool.title: PENALTY ZONE: SHADOW ASSASSINS
penalty_pool.description: You are surrounded. You must stay low to the ground and evade constant strikes from the shadows.

penalty_pool.title: PENALTY ZONE: TITAN'S GRIP
penalty_pool.description: The floor has vanished. Your survival depends entirely on the endurance of your forearms.

targets.E-Rank: Accumulate 2 minutes of Dead Hangs (or Heavy DB Holds)
targets.D-Rank: Accumulate 3 minutes of Dead Hangs (or Heavy DB Holds)

penalty_pool.title: PENALTY ZONE: MANA BURN
penalty_pool.description: Your mana circuits are stalling. You must force a massive metabolic spike to clear the blockage.

targets.E-Rank: 15 mins Walking Pad Intervals (1 min max incline/speed, 1 min slow)
targets.D-Rank: 20 mins Walking Pad Intervals (1 min max incline/speed, 1 min slow)
targets.C-Rank: 30 mins Walking Pad Intervals (1 min max incline/speed, 1 min slow)
targets.B-Rank: 45 mins Walking Pad Intervals (1 min max incline/speed, 1 min slow)
targets.A-Rank: 60 mins Walking Pad Intervals (1 min max incline/speed, 1 min slow)
